stages.label: Hardware
stages.sentence: Boards designed for the enclosure, power budget, and certification lab, not just the bench.

stages.label: Firmware
stages.sentence: Firmware that boots safely, recovers from faults, and updates remotely in the field.

stages.label: Connectivity
stages.sentence: Radio and protocol architectures for intermittent sites, buffering data locally until the link returns.

stages.label: Fleet operations
stages.sentence: Zero-touch provisioning, staged OTA updates with rollback, and remote diagnostics per unit.

stages.label: Cloud and data
stages.sentence: Device registries, ingestion pipelines, APIs, and dashboards built as code and sized for the fleet.

stages.label: Edge AI
stages.sentence: Computer vision and inference models running next to the sensor, even when the network drops.

stages.label: AI agents
stages.sentence: Agents wired to device data and business systems through permissioned, audited tools.
